source.reuse: The final source is fully requalified after padded query ownership was added. The additional permanent one-warp spatial-tail sanitizer fixture changes tests only: every src/ hash matches the performance snapshot. All performance, reference and GPU-suite rows below use tail-final-v1; tail-release-v1 adds four sanitizer passes for the selected tail owner.

contract: B1, D64, equal heads, contiguous BTHWHD synthetic LTX shapes; normalized rounded Q/K, Q pre-scaled by 0.125, scale=1; complete eager inference attention call, not complete decoder. KohakuFA two-term P and corrected backward retained. Comfy Kitchen has a different probability rounding policy; timings compare complete implementations.
timing: Nine alternating-order samples, nominal 200 ms each after compilation/allocation/cache warmup; synchronized wall time primary, CUDA events retained. Graph results separately measure resident replay with API GPU work inside capture. Samples_ms columns: wall_ms, event_ms.
acceptance: Independent per-head output norm limit 0.5% FP16, 1% BF16 at boundary queries plus128 fixed-seed sampled queries for eager rows; BF16 graph checks use64 sampled queries. Full-coordinate small geometries additionally check each O/dQ/dK/dV component against native CPU FP64 on identical rounded inputs and actual-O corrected equations. Directed tests retain their established gates.
selection: Tile screening used stage2, stage5 and subsequently fallback-tail, seed6173. The six LTX shapes and width65 are development workloads. Heldout13f, heldout33f, heldout-spatial-tails and heldout-spatial-tails-wide are independent geometry evaluations; final evaluation seed99173. No model-quality claim.
software_review: Comfy Kitchen0.2.41 is the current inspected release; its CUDA na3d source matches inspected main. Torch2.15.0 was current at review, but the previously qualified Torch2.13.0+cu130 stack is retained for a same-stack scheduling comparison.

experiments.name: screen-v1
experiments.outcome: Aligned query-tile and register-Q sweep; did not close the H100 large-window gap.

experiments.name: screen-v2
experiments.outcome: Simple cp.async prefetch regressed measured H100 cases; not retained.

experiments.name: hopper-tma-v1
experiments.outcome: Single-buffer TMA H100 large-window path remained slower than Comfy Kitchen.

experiments.name: hopper-tma-v2
experiments.outcome: Double-buffer TMA H100 large-window path remained slower than Comfy Kitchen.

experiments.name: union-v1
experiments.outcome: Compilation rejected missing vector-alignment proof; no successful timing. Proof fixed and tests retained.

experiments.name: union-v3
experiments.outcome: Controlled union column/tile sweep selected 1x4x4 C32 small windows and 1x4x8 C32 large windows.

experiments.name: matrix-v1
experiments.outcome: Same-process prior default, union candidate and Comfy Kitchen development matrix across four GPUs.

experiments.name: native-v1
experiments.outcome: Same-GPU arithmetic through native versus Python host packing: approximately24us less host overhead on RTX5090 small calls.

experiments.name: native-v2
experiments.outcome: Moving output/statistics allocation into native entry removes a further approximately8us on the same RTX5090 screen.

experiments.name: tail-screen-v1
experiments.outcome: Correctness passed for padded query ownership; timing wrapper accidentally reset experimental selection. Its generic timings are not candidate measurements.

experiments.name: tail-screen-v2
experiments.outcome: Explicit candidate selection verified; 1x4x4 C32 selected for nonmultiple-of-eight spatial dimensions after comparison with 1x4x8/1x8x4 and C64. Independent spatial-tail geometries evaluated only after selection.

upstream_integration.change_scope: Upstream docs/data only; resolved documentation overlap retaining current union/tail behavior and prior cross-architecture evidence links.

earlier_5090_archive.scope: Initial aligned-shape and native-host development on RTX5090 at575W with EPYC7742. Final tail-inclusive results use a replacement full RTX5090 at500W with EPYC7642, as independently paired with Comfy Kitchen below.
